name: music_nod
description: Subtle head nod synchronized to music; two nods per 8-frame loop

pivot.note: foot contact plane ~y=588 px in 608 px cell

motion: Feet planted, arms in pockets, face always invisible, small nod only

playback.whenBeatClockAvailable: phase = ((audioTimeSeconds - beatStartSeconds) * bpm / 60) % 2; index = floor(phase / 2 * 8). Use modulo for negative phase.
playback.withoutBeatClock: play 8 frames at referenceFps*(bpm/120); default 8 fps if BPM unavailable
playback.defaultState: Do not override existing idle/step logic. Enable when character is idling while music is active.
